answer: Bind earning rights to a non-transferable track record: an identity unlocks rewards only after many epochs of jury-graded answers, its history growing like a plume, feather by feather. A single sonnet is cheap to fake, but months of coherent, peer-approved work is not. Reputation behaves like yarrow: it roots slowly and cannot be rushed. A Sybil farmer must pay that full time-and-quality cost for every fake identity, so attacking ends up costing more than honesty pays.
